candidates.description: This vector activates subwords and characters related to Hindi script and terminology alongside fragmented English tokens.
This vector represents Devanagari script characters containing the consonant 'ध' (dha) along with related vowel modifiers and typographical noise.
This feature vector represents common Hindi prefixes, roots, and frequent word-initial character n-grams.
This vector activates for specific consonant combinations and vowel matras in Devanagari script.
This vector activates for sub-word units and characters commonly found in Hindi script and Devanagari text.
This vector represents characters, subwords, and morphemes from Indic scripts, predominantly Devanagari.
This vector represents common Hindi vowel signs and consonant-vowel conjuncts used in Devanagari script.
This feature vector activates strongly on common consonant characters and subword tokens across various languages, particularly Indic scripts.
This vector is related to characters and sub-word components of the Hindi Devanagari script.
This feature vector is related to Hindi vowel signs and diacritic modifiers used in Indic script typography and encoding.
